Name: Even Better Artisan Good Icons for Joja Seeds Redux
Author: waterscapes
Description:
Hello, I'm back again to update EBAGI icons for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50846?tab=posts]Joja Seeds Redux[/url] mod. Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/dark8807]dark8807[/url] for allowing me to modify their code to make this update!

I updated the juice icons to match the new 1.6 look for juices and added assets for the Appleberry (Jelly and Wine) and Butterflypea (Honey). However, if you like the old style of juice, I left those in the assets folder as a file named xjuice.png. If you want to use the old style, open the file named data.json, and change the line 
[code]"Juice": "assets/juice.png",[/code]to 
[code]"Juice": "assets/xjuice.png",[/code]That's all you need to do!

To install:

1. Drag "[EBAGI] Joja Seeds Redux" into your Mods folder.

To uninstall:

1. Delete "[EBAGI] Joja Seeds Redux" from your Mods folder.
